gates.description: suite_schema MUST equal CS-0@3.0.0 across contract, gates, and manifest.
gates.failure_message: Bundle suite_schema drift detected; RUST-1 artifacts are not aligned to CS-0@3.0.0.
gates.title: Bundle suite schema parity

gates.description: bundle.manifest.json filename and manifest file list MUST match the bundle contents exactly.
gates.failure_message: Manifest filename or manifest file inventory does not match the actual bundle contents.
gates.title: Manifest filename and contents

gates.description: Contract, gates, and manifest linkage MUST agree on doc_id, version, and bundle identity.
gates.failure_message: Contract, test gates, or manifest linkage does not match RUST-1 bundle identity.
gates.title: Artifact linkage and version parity

details.equals: Native code MAY accelerate and verify; it MUST NOT become authoritative for tenant authorization, policy evaluation, inventory truth, price authority, order finalization, ledger posting, refund approval, payout eligibility, or admission truth.

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST explicitly forbid native code from becoming business authority for core platform truth domains.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer keeps native code subordinate to the governed core platform contracts.
gates.title: Boundary authority remains in core contracts

gates.description: Normal and DirtyCpu execution tiers MUST remain side-effect-free and scheduler-safe, with unbounded or blocking work pushed outside the BEAM.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 scheduler discipline drifted; a dangerous NIF execution mode may now be permitted.
gates.title: Scheduler and NIF boundary discipline

gates.description: Edge and scanner native code MUST remain verification-only and MUST NOT receive private signing authority.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer enforces public-key-only verification on edge devices.
gates.title: Public-key-only edge verification

gates.description: Native hash and signature preimages MUST preserve the platform UUID ordering constitution.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer preserves deterministic raw-byte UUID ordering for cryptographic and tie-break surfaces.
gates.title: UUID preimage ordering discipline

gates.description: Native code supply-chain controls and unsafe-default bans MUST remain enforced.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer enforces the minimum native supply-chain and unsafe-code controls.
gates.title: Supply-chain and unsafe-code discipline

gates.description: Proof-of-work and other compute taxes MUST remain adaptive controls, not default friction for good-standing authenticated users.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 now allows proof-of-work to become default user friction rather than an adaptive abuse control.
gates.title: Economic defense remains adaptive, not default

gates.description: Security-critical native failures MUST remain fail-closed and visible; silent bypass is forbidden.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer forces fail-closed and observable behavior for security-relevant native failures.
gates.title: Native failures remain fail-closed where security matters

gates.description: RUST-1 canonical content MUST avoid placeholders and banned vocabulary that would drift away from project conventions.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 contains placeholder text or banned vocabulary in canonical sections.
gates.title: Canonical terminology and placeholder bans

gates.description: RUST-1 dependency and lineage floors MUST anchor the contract to CS-0, BP-0, and V42-0.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 dependency floors or foundation references drifted away from the intended constitutional anchors.
gates.title: Dependency and foundation floor discipline

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST explicitly forbid mutable global native state, request-derived runtime caches, and shared verifier pools in v1.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer bans mutable native state strongly enough for v1.
gates.title: Mutable native state remains banned in v1

gates.description: Security-critical native load failure MUST fail closed or fail boot, and fallback behavior MUST remain deterministic and observable.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer governs native loader and fallback semantics tightly enough.
gates.title: Loader and fallback semantics remain fail-closed

gates.description: Android native integration MUST stay inside a minimal governed JNI bridge and MUST NOT gain business workflow or network authority.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer constrains JNI tightly enough for edge-native verification.
gates.title: Android JNI boundary remains minimal and governed

gates.description: Edge verification keysets MUST remain kid-addressable, versioned, time-bounded, and revocation-aware.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer defines an explicit governed verification-key lifecycle for offline verification.
gates.title: Verification keyset lifecycle remains explicit

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST keep an explicit native error surface and forbid raw panic payload logging.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer defines or protects the governed native error surface.
gates.title: Native-specific error surface remains governed

gates.description: Native boundaries MUST keep explicit input, output, parser, and allocation ceilings.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer maintains bounded native resource and parser rules.
gates.title: Resource ceilings and parser rules remain bounded

gates.description: Native verification, parser, and canonicalization surfaces MUST retain fuzzing, golden vectors, and runtime-harness declarations.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer requires sufficient test and runtime evidence for native activation.
gates.title: Testing and runtime evidence remain mandatory

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST keep repo-level governance lint hooks for native-boundary anti-patterns.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer requires repo-level lint enforcement for native-boundary anti-patterns.
gates.title: Repo lint hooks remain part of native governance

gates.description: RUST-1 SHOULD declare runtime-harness assertions for telemetry and error-envelope linkage even though static CI cannot execute them alone.
gates.failure_message: Runtime-harness declarations for native telemetry and error correlation are missing.
gates.title: Runtime telemetry declarations exist for native paths

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST keep all native capability classes in an eligible-only state until a downstream owner contract explicitly adopts and budgets them.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 now allows native capabilities to be activated without explicit downstream contract adoption and budgeting.
gates.title: Capability enablement requires explicit downstream adoption

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST keep an explicit per-capability adoption matrix so native usage cannot spread by implication or undocumented convention.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer keeps an explicit capability adoption matrix with governed default statuses.
gates.title: Capability adoption matrix remains explicit

gates.description: Native-path enablement MUST remain blocked until ERR-1 registration and downstream error mapping discipline are explicit.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer requires ERR-1 registration discipline before native-specific error usage reaches the suite.
gates.title: ERR-1 registration remains mandatory before suite use

gates.description: RUST-1 global ceilings MUST remain enablement guards only; each adopted capability still needs a tighter downstream contract budget.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer forces downstream capability budgets or now allows downstream budgets to exceed native hard ceilings.
gates.title: RUST-1 budgets remain hard ceilings only

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST remain anchored to TG-0, LINT-0, and GOV-0 so native-boundary lint and waiver discipline cannot drift into convention-only governance.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer keeps explicit governance-floor dependencies for test-gate, lint, and waiver discipline.
gates.title: Governance floor dependencies remain explicit

gates.description: Capability matrix entries MUST explicitly state that the owning contract remains authoritative and native code does not become authority by implementation choice.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 capability matrix no longer states ownership authority explicitly, reintroducing semantic ambiguity around native authority.
gates.title: Capability matrix authority terminology remains explicit

gates.description: Verification keysets MUST remain monotonic, signed for remote updates, and rollback-protected for offline trust.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer enforces explicit keyset anti-rollback and signed update discipline.
gates.title: Keyset anti-rollback and signed update discipline remain explicit

gates.description: Android-native releases MUST declare supported ABIs and keep JNI communication coarse-grained and governed.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer governs Android ABI packaging and JNI call-shape discipline explicitly.
gates.title: Android ABI packaging and JNI discipline remain explicit

gates.description: Native capability activation MUST remain blocked by missing runtime proof, mapping, or budgets, and budget rejection telemetry MUST remain governed.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer makes runtime activation blockers and budget rejection signals explicit.
gates.title: Runtime activation blockers and budget rejection signals remain explicit

gates.description: RUST-1 MUST keep repo-lint hooks for fallback bypass, ERR-1 bypass, native authority transfer, and keyset rollback bypass.
gates.failure_message: RUST-1 no longer keeps the expanded repo-lint governance hooks required to police native-boundary drift.
gates.title: Expanded native-boundary lint hooks remain explicit

gates.description: TKT-1 MAY be a candidate owner only for credential-envelope parse, canonicalization, fingerprinting, and public-key verification. Native code MUST NOT become authority for issuance, payment, inventory, admission, transfer, refund, or revocation decisions.
gates.failure_message: TKT-1 native eligibility drifted beyond credential-envelope computation or native authority bans were weakened.
gates.title: TKT-1 credential-envelope eligibility remains narrow
